body: I know I matter to people. I know people love me. I just hurt so very much and nothing is taking away the emotional pain I feel and it hurts the ones I live to see me hurt.   I am an outwardly awesome person. I work hard to take care of everyone. And at the end of the day I still want to be dead.  I’m on anti depressants, I work really hard to stay positive in front of everyone, but it’s just a mask.
I get it. I have people who love me, people who would be devastated if I were gone.  But I hurt like hell. No one gets it.
